_note: Source of truth for docs/FILE-INVENTORY.md §3 descriptions. Line counts and the file list are DERIVED by `npm run inventory` — edit only titles, notes, ordering and descriptions here.

sections.title: `scripts/crawl-strip/` — the top strip + movement + combat sync

descriptions.scripts/shadowdark-enhancer.mjs: **Entry point** (module.json esmodules). Registers hooks, settings, sheets, actor sub-types, the public `game.shadowdarkEnhancer` API, and wires every sub-system.
descriptions.scripts/shared/module-id.mjs: Single source of truth for the module ID (highest fan-in file: 58 importers).
descriptions.scripts/shared/source-keys.mjs: One canonical key per source book (core/cs1-6/wr) across every spelling.
descriptions.scripts/shared/icons.mjs: Centralized icon registry — FontAwesome snippets and vendored SVG references.
descriptions.scripts/shared/compendium-suite.mjs: Find-or-create layer for the five managed packs (`sde-actors/items/tables/journal/scenes`); 38 importers.
descriptions.scripts/shared/loading-dialog-guard.mjs: Guards the system's leaked `LoadingSD` spinner when `ItemSheetSD.getData` throws.
descriptions.scripts/shared/art-utils.mjs: Portrait/token image resolution across world + compendium sources.
descriptions.scripts/crawl-strip/crawl-strip.mjs: The core feature: the top strip. Plain DOM (`#shadowdark-enhancer-strip`), not ApplicationV2.
descriptions.scripts/crawl-strip/crawl-state.mjs: Foundry-coupled state singleton — persistence, sockets, hook emission.
descriptions.scripts/crawl-strip/crawl-lights-core.mj: Pure light-source logic for the strip's flame badges.
descriptions.scripts/crawl-strip/initiative-manager.m: Combat/initiative state machine glue for the strip.
descriptions.scripts/crawl-strip/movement-tracker.mjs: Crawl-mode movement budget enforcement + turn-start rollback (`displace` waypoints).
descriptions.scripts/crawl-bar/crawl-bar.mjs: GM-only persistent bottom bar above the macro bar (mode toggles, tools, launchers).
descriptions.scripts/encounter/encounter-roller-app.m: The Encounter Roller shell + tabs (Roll Tables / Build / Browse / Creator).
descriptions.scripts/encounter/encounter-check.mjs: The d6 random-encounter check + chat post.
descriptions.scripts/encounter/encounter-build.mjs: Build-a-table data layer (slots, die formats, save to RollTable).
descriptions.scripts/encounter/encounter-browse.mjs: Browse-NPCs data layer (sources, loading, cache, filter/sort).
descriptions.scripts/encounter/npc-index.mjs: NPC actors → compact browse row model.
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/encounter-creato: Monster Creator — multi-section NPC authoring tool mounted in the roller.
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/action-templates: Quick-pick NPC attack/action catalog (FA6 Free glyphs only).
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/monster-effect-r: Provenance-backed effect overlay engine for the Creator draft.
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/monster-mechanic: Sole authority for what mechanics a generator result actually applies.
Clone an existing NPC and apply imported matrix results.
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/monster-table-ru: Reads the GM's own imported Core matrix tables to drive the Generator/Mutator.
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/spell-index.mjs: Lightweight Spell index (compendium indices, not documents).
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/npc-moves.mjs: Canonical NPC movement keys with a pre-config fallback.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-generator-app.mjs: Roll a loot table, work a running batch, whisper claimable cards.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-generator.mjs: RollTable → structured loot batch (documents, coins, flavor).
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-delivery.mjs: Shared claimable chat card; first-claim-wins, GM-authoritative over socket.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-drops.mjs: Auto-drop loot on NPC defeat at combat end.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-setup-app.mjs: Browsable Loot & Treasure library; rows unlock from the GM's own PDF.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-value.mjs: gp value → Shadowdark XP quality tiers.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-table-catalog.mjs: Loot/treasure table catalog + classifier across Core, CS1–6, WR (metadata only).
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-table-tag.mjs: Sidebar context-menu "Mark as Loot Table" toggle.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-catalog.mjs: Rewrites loot tables so entries become DOCUMENT results.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-linker.mjs: Loot row text → confident compendium item link.
descriptions.scripts/loot/loot-pack.mjs: Classify/fabricate treasure entries + world "Loot" pack ops.
descriptions.scripts/loot/subroll.mjs: Resolve "Meteorite 1d4: 1. lute…" table rows to the object rolled.
descriptions.scripts/loot/item-drops.mjs: Drag items to canvas as pickup tokens; TokenHUD pickup; light sources burn.
descriptions.scripts/magic-forge/magic-forge-app.mjs: Magic Item Forge window (weapons/armor with working +N, benefit/curse riders).
descriptions.scripts/magic-forge/magic-forge.mjs: Core engine building items that actually function in the system.
Drives forge recipes off the GM's own imported magic-item tables.
descriptions.scripts/merchant/merchant-shop.mjs: Two-mode shop system (compendium global or actor NPC inventory); GM opens for all players.
descriptions.scripts/merchant/merchant-defaults.mjs: The two shipped merchant configs (Base, Western Reaches).
descriptions.scripts/party-xp/party-xp.mjs: Award XP to the whole party in one click (ApplicationV2 GM tool).
descriptions.scripts/session-recap/session-recap.mjs: Session event tracker singleton (loot, sales, XP, combats, per-PC stats).
descriptions.scripts/session-recap/session-recap-core: Pure data shape, currency math, duration format, Discord-markdown export.
Recap window: Overview / Combat / Loot / XP / History.
descriptions.scripts/importer/importer-hub-app.mjs: **The single front door (shell).** ApplicationV2 lifecycle, singleton, instance fields/caches, `_prepareContext`; installs the three method packs below onto the class (split 2026-07-22).
descriptions.scripts/importer/importer-hub-paste.mjs: Paste box, type selector, parse dispatch, per-type preview field/row wiring.
descriptions.scripts/importer/importer-hub-commit.mjs: Conflict dialogs, quality gates, magic-bundle plan, all per-type commit flows.
descriptions.scripts/importer/importer-hub-manage.mjs: Manage strip: censuses + caches, manage tree, gap/seed/cull, source-PDF grab/extract.
descriptions.scripts/importer/dump-segmenter.mjs: Routes a mixed dump through the recognizer registry: hexcrawl → spell → monster → item → table.
descriptions.scripts/importer/bundle-io.mjs: Whole-suite export/import as one JSON; validates, skips existing, never overwrites.
descriptions.scripts/importer/manage-tree.mjs: Composes the folder/sub-folder unlock-review tree the Manage strip renders.
descriptions.scripts/importer/pdf-text-extract.mjs: Clean reading-ordered PDF text via Foundry's bundled PDF.js; column-aware gutter detection.
descriptions.scripts/importer/pdf-text-utils.mjs: Shared PDF-text helpers + the HTML-safety contract.
descriptions.scripts/importer/source-pdf-registry.mjs: Content source → the user's own uploaded PDF, for page deep-links.
descriptions.scripts/importer/source-pdf-viewer.mjs: Singleton ApplicationV2 embedding Foundry's PDF.js viewer at a given page.
descriptions.scripts/importer/char-content/char-conte: Metadata-only manifest of CS4–6 + WR char-builder content (names/types/sources, no rules text) + `parseCharContent` + census.
descriptions.scripts/importer/char-content/class-pars: Class section → structured unit (writeup, talents, tables, spellcasting). Pure.
descriptions.scripts/importer/char-content/class-unit: Class unit → real documents in dependency order.
descriptions.scripts/importer/char-content/class-over: SDE-original automation not derivable from book text (ActiveEffects, invented names).
descriptions.scripts/importer/char-content/class-qual: The one place computing blocking class-import issues + override dialog.
descriptions.scripts/importer/char-content/class-inde: Class name → system Class item UUID.
descriptions.scripts/importer/spells/spell-importer-a: Spell workspace organized by class / tier / alignment.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-importer.m: Roll-table text → structure. The big one; includes `repairSharedStartRanges`.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-shapes.mjs: Per-unlock deterministic table SHAPE recipes (prayer/grid/lookup/reflow kinds).
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-hub.mjs: Reconciles the shipped manifest against the live world (system / imported / missing).
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-hub-app.mj: "Set up ALL tables" window — dashboard + import view.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-registry.m: Parses live tables into `{source, page, displayName, subCategory}` and groups them.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-structure-: Structure-only seeds (formulas, folders, flags, chain links).
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-folders.mj: Single source of truth for where a table files in `sde-tables` — **owns the Gameplay vs Roll Tables split**.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-enrich.mjs: Brings imported tables to "Ruin Encounters" standard; owns the debounced auto-relink sweep.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/core-table-group: Core Rulebook table groups (`section: "gameplay"` vs roll tables) for the Manage tree.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/hex-parser.mjs: Hex-key dumps → per-hex draft journal pages. Pure.
descriptions.scripts/importer/monsters/statblock-pars: Monster statblock dump → draft objects. Pure.
descriptions.scripts/importer/monsters/monster-import: Paste dump → per-monster preview/edit grid → create.
descriptions.scripts/importer/monsters/monster-backfi: Idempotent upgrade of pre-fidelity-fix imports; auto-runs once per module version.
descriptions.scripts/importer/monsters/actor-migratio: World-side imported actors → the managed `sde-actors` pack.
descriptions.scripts/importer/monsters/monster-linker: Table encounter text → clickable `@UUID` monster links.
descriptions.scripts/importer/monsters/monster-pack.m: Shared pack-identity leaf so importer and linker agree.
descriptions.scripts/importer/items/gear-parser.mjs: Real Weapon/Armor stat parser (WR letter codes, treasure flags). Pure.
descriptions.scripts/importer/items/gear-join.mjs: Joins split cost-table + description layouts into one item. Pure.
descriptions.scripts/importer/items/item-importer.mjs: Drafts → Items in `sde-items`, foldered by source.
descriptions.scripts/importer/items/item-builder-gear: Pure stage-①/③ logic for the Item Builder.
Items census adapter (same shape as monsters).
descriptions.scripts/importer/items/shikashi-icons.mj: Item name → bundled Shikashi icon matcher (284 icons).
descriptions.scripts/actors/boat-data-model.mjs: Boat data model — WR vessel rules.
descriptions.scripts/actors/boat-sheet.mjs: Boat sheet: Overview / Passengers & Crew / Cargo / Description.
descriptions.scripts/actors/mount-npc-sheet.mjs: Mount sheet — subclass of the system's `NpcSheetSD`.
descriptions.scripts/importer/boats/mount-parser.mjs: Names-only WR mount manifest + selection of the requested mount from parsed statblock drafts.
descriptions.scripts/importer/boats/mount-importer.mj: Mount drafts → `shadowdark-enhancer.mount` actors in `sde-actors`, reusing the monster import pipeline.
descriptions.scripts/importer/boats/boat-parser.mjs: Parses the WR p118 boats table → boat actor drafts (pure); names-only manifest.
descriptions.scripts/importer/boats/siege-parser.mjs: Parses the WR p119 siege-weapons table → Weapon drafts + ammunition (pure).
descriptions.scripts/importer/boats/siege-importer.mj: Materializes Blast/Exploding Property items for the siege weapons in `sde-items`.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/char-builder-app.mj: `ShadowdarkCharBuilder` ApplicationV2 shell; drives the step lifecycle.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/constants.mjs: Shared constants; hands off to the system's `CharacterGeneratorSD`.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/data.mjs: Thin wrappers over the system's compendium loaders.
Per-day/roll uses for Class Ability items.
descriptions.scripts/monster-art/monster-token-art.mj: Applies licensed art to monsters **by path reference**, never bundled.
descriptions.scripts/pdf-export/pdf-sheet-export.mjs: "Export to PDF" header button; fills the bundled form-fillable sheet from SD data-model getters.
descriptions.scripts/encounter/encounter-sources.mjs: Pure, node-testable core for the Encounter Roller's source list (which tables/monsters feed a roll).
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/level-guidelines: GM-facing editor for the per-level monster guidelines — what a level-N monster's stats should look like.
Pure, node-testable monster level-guideline math (isotonic-smoothed medians over the system's 244 monsters).
descriptions.scripts/monster-creator/quick-adjust-app: Quick stat-adjust dialog — lightweight AC/HP/level/attack swaps on an existing monster (not a generated effect).
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-manifest.m: Table manifest logic — the registry of catalogued tables (id, name, source, page) that drives the Manage-tree census.
descriptions.scripts/importer/tables/table-manifest-d: The `TABLE_MANIFEST` data array — every catalogued table's metadata (names/sources/pages; no rules text).
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/base-step.mjs: Base class for character-builder wizard steps (shared lifecycle, render and validation).
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/list-step.mjs: Base class for the list/detail/aside steps (Ancestry, Class, Background, Deity).
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/alignment-ste: Step — Alignment. Three choice cards (Lawful / Neutral / Chaotic).
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/ancestry-step: Step — Ancestry. List/detail pick contributing ancestry talents and languages.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/background-st: Step — Background. A simple list/detail pick.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/class-step.mj: Step — Class. List/detail pick; parses the class writeup, talent table and spellcasting.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/deity-step.mj: Step — Deity. Optional list/detail pick showing the deity's detail.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/gear-step.mjs: Step — Gear. A shop: browse purchasable equipment and buy against starting gold.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/gold-step.mjs: Step — Gold. Roll 2d6×5 gp, or use the GM's fixed starting-gold setting.
Step — Hit Points & Gold on one tab (both are single dice rolls).
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/hp-step.mjs: Step — Hit Points. Level-1 HP = class hit die + CON modifier (minimum 1).
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/languages-ste: Step — Languages (runs after Class, so ancestry and class both contribute).
Step — Origins: Background + Alignment + Deity on one tab.
Step — Preview. Final character-sheet preview before creation.
descriptions.scripts/char-builder/steps/stats-step.mj: Step — Abilities. Roll or assign the six ability scores.
descriptions.scripts/character-sheet/prayer-roll.mjs: Prayer icon beside the sheet's Deity header; rolls that deity's `<Deity> Prayers` table (world first, then compendiums).
descriptions.scripts/luck-reroll/luck-reroll.mjs: Wraps the system's `_onReroll` to enforce nat-1 prevention and log Luck rerolls to the session recap.
descriptions.scripts/spell-mishap/spell-mishap.mjs: Nat-1 spellcasting failures auto-roll the class's mishap table (wizard / witch / necromancer sets); divine casters are exempt.
